DO NOT EAT HERE! TOURIST TRAP
May 2026 • Friends
DO NOT EAT HERE! TOURIST TRAP!

I have to first state that I’m Vietnamese who lives abroad for a long time as well so I can understand different taste profiles and be more tolerant if touristy place like this restaurant has sub par quality. But Thia Go is a shock to me on all fronts: bad food, bad service, limited menu. It’s more shocking that this place gets more than 4 star review and because of that we all fall into this trap.

What happened? We ordered 4 different dishes, 2 drinks. The tamarind drink was as expected but all 4 dishes failed, especially for my Bun Bo hue. The soup is tasteless and the meat (beef) is hard like it goes straight from a freezer without proper cooking time. The spring rolls are mushy and soaked in oil…

But to make it worse, when I let the manager know she said : sorry the foods is not tasty because they cook for “foreigners” implying it can be bad like that and foreigners wouldn’t know or complain. She refused to exchange it or take it off the menu knowing I can’t even eat my foods…. I told her it’s ok I am willing to pay the full price because 78k is nothing I just want them to respect tourists to prepare better foods, …but the message doesn’t get through. My friend’s pho is horrible as well, he mentioned it’s so bland and offered me to taste it to verify. I thought the pho looked great but when I tasted the soup it’s super bland and tasteless… what a disgrace!

Plus you get charged 20% on top on certain days and 2.5% for credit card payment.

So guys! DO NOT EAT HERE!!! Go to BEP CUON instead. Bep Cuon is also touristy but at least the foods is good.

Also, do others a favor, stop giving 5 stars when you don’t really know the foods scene, it’s misleading for other fellows. Talking as a local here… eat elsewhere. We have tons of great foods!
